description: This file defines the interface for the CloudStore plugin class in the WPEFramework project. It declares the CloudStore class along with nested classes for configuration, notifications, and remote connection handling. The file sets up the class inheritance, interface mappings, and member functions for initialization and shutdown procedures, as well as internal state management.

classes.name: CloudStore
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing the CloudStore service with interfaces for plugin lifecycle, JSON-RPC handling, and internal notifications.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Configuration container for the CloudStore, managing the URI setting.

classes.name: Store2Notification
classes.description: Notification handler for changes in the store, relays events to the parent CloudStore instance.

classes.name: RemoteConnectionNotification
classes.description: Handles remote connection events, especially deactivation, and triggers service shutdown.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the CloudStore plugin with the provided service shell.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources when the plugin is deinitialized.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Provides status or informational string about the plugin.
